Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: A daily personal expense entry logged by the user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

title.description: Short label or merchant description (1..80 chars).

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for the expense.

dateEpochDay.description: LocalDate epoch day for timezone-stable daily grouping.

receiptPhotoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG receipt or invoice photo encoded in Base64 (<= 200000 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

MonthlyBudget.title: MonthlyBudget
MonthlyBudget.description: Automatically composed or customized monthly budget plan for a given YYYY-MM month.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

monthKey.description: Year-month identifier in YYYY-MM format matching document ID.

categoryBudgets.description: Map of category keys to allocated IDR limits.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

RecurringTemplate.title: RecurringTemplate
RecurringTemplate.description: Reusable recurring monthly bill or expense template for 1-tap logging.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User-customizable profile metadata overriding Google account display name.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Custom display name chosen by the user (1..50 chars).

photoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG avatar encoded in Base64 (<= 150000 chars); empty string syncs Google photo.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

SavingsGoal.title: SavingsGoal
SavingsGoal.description: User-tracked savings goal (Celengan Impian) recording target and saved amounts.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

targetAmount.description: Target savings goal amount in IDR (positive integer).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

WalletBalance.title: WalletBalance
WalletBalance.description: User-tracked balance for a personal payment source (Cash, QRIS, Transfer, Card).

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method key matching document ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

/users/{userId}.description: User-owned profile document storing custom display name.

/users/{userId}/budgets/{monthKey}.description: User-owned monthly budget plans keyed by YYYY-MM.

/users/{userId}/recurringTemplates/{temp.description: User-owned recurring expense templates for 1-tap monthly logging.

/users/{userId}/walletBalances/{methodKe.description: User-owned tracked wallet balances keyed by PaymentMethod.
